Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! We ave the two teams who will be fighting for the cup and it is India and England! They finals will be played on the 29th of this month. The game begins at 1715 IST (1145 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!
Hannah L Baker has been given the Player of the Match award!

Australia will be very disappointed, this was a total they would have backed themselves to chase. It was a matter of just the one good innings or just the one good partnership but that was not the case. A couple of their batters did get off to starts but none went onto make it big and that is what cost them. There were also a few soft dismissals and they have given away a game they should have won.

What a game of cricket! What a bowling performance from England! They are over the moon at the moment and rightly so. It seemed all ver for them after their poor batting performance but they believed, they came out with intent with the ball and the energy was high in the field for them. They got wickets at regular intervals. Whenever the Aussies managed to build a partnership, they managed to find a breakthrough. Almost all their bowlers got a wicket at least but the pick was Hannah L Baker who got three and changed the course of the game totaly.

OUT! THE FINGER IS RAISED! There is the last wicket and it is England who are through to the finals! What a performance by them! The skipper gets the last wicket. On middle, Maggie Clark looks to drive but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. ENGLAND WIN BY 3 RUNS!
